messages:
anya: Quick sync — we need to finalize soft-preempt window + backfill policy for Dedicated pools before the next rollout. Current problem: tenants get preempted mid-request & backfill steals prewarm credits. Thoughts?
jonathan: Agree, saw 3 customer incidents last week where long-stream requests got killed. :grimacing: 
kevin: Proposed: soft-preempt window = 30s. Mark node as 'draining-soon' and don't schedule new requests with expected tail > window. Backfill can only use >10% spare capacity and not touch prewarm credits.
mara: How do we estimate expected tail? we have p95 latency per model but variable seq len.
kevin: Use sampling: model-level tail estimator from recent 5m, plus a safety multiplier of 1.5. If unknown model, default 60s.
sam: Can we add a fast-path where user sets request hint header: `x-infer-time-hint: 20`? then admission uses it.
anya: I like hints. Need to prevent tenant gaming it. limit hint <= tenant.SLA_window and require TTL.
priya: Regarding backfill, suggest two tiers: opportunistic (uses GPU if idle > 2m), and revocable (can be killed instantly but doesn't touch prewarm credits). That way we preserve QoS.
jonathan: Also need to pin canary: new policy rollout to 5% of pools, monitor evictions and 99 latency for 48h.
deploy-bot: CI: policy tests passed on staging. image: inference-orch:v2026.03
kevin: Draft policy snippet:
```
soft_preempt_window_secs: 30
tail_estimator: recent_5m_p95 * 1.5
backfill:
  opportunistic_min_idle_secs: 120
  max_cpu_fraction: 0.1
  revocable: true
```

mara: UX ops question — what happens when soft-preempt still can't free node? fallback to hard preempt after grace of 90s?
kevin: yes, escalate to hard preempt at 90s and trigger tenant alert + automatic retry on other pool.
anya: Next steps: kevin to write KEP and operator flags, sam to add request hint header, priya to prototype backfill controller. Rollout plan drafted. Meeting Friday 9am to review KEP. :thumbsup: 
jonathan: SGTM
sam: I'll open PRs today
priya: will spike controller tomorrow
deploy-bot: scheduled meeting created: Friday 09:00 (calendar link)
anya: thanks everyone — let's keep the policy minimal and observable.
